title: Which career path should I take?
body:
Staying: good salary, boring work.
Freelancing: unstable income, freedom.
Startup: equity, long hours.
note: I have six months of savings, so the income risk is smaller than it looks.

history.text: Two options and four words of reasoning. Impressive economy.
Equity is a lottery ticket, not a plan. What's the strike price?

comments.text: Good compared to what? Give the figure.
comments.reason: It's 20% above market for my role, I checked.

comments.text: Equity is worth nothing until it's liquid. Say what it's worth.
